title: RDP Session
description: Schema describing an active or historical RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol) session on a Remote Desktop Services host, including session state and client information.

sessionId.description: Unique integer identifier for the session on the RDS host.

username.description: The user account name logged into this session.

domain.description: The Active Directory domain of the logged-in user.

state.description: Current state of the RDP session as reported by Remote Desktop Services.

clientName.description: Computer name of the RDP client device.

clientAddress.description: IP address of the connecting RDP client.

clientProtocol.description: Protocol version reported by the RDP client.

logonTime.description: Timestamp when the user logged onto the session.

disconnectTime.description: Timestamp when the session was disconnected, if applicable.

hostName.description: Name of the Remote Desktop Session Host (RDSH) server.

encryptionLevel.description: Encryption level negotiated for this RDP session.
